scripts.build:ios: yarn sync:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -archivePath ./build/App.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.build:android: yarn sync:android && cd android/ && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../build/
scripts.build:ipa: NODE_ENV=production yarn sync:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates ${XCODEBUILD_AUTH_ARGS:-} DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$APPLE_TEAM_ID" MARKETING_VERSION="$npm_package_version" CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M)" archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/App/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build/export -allowProvisioningUpdates ${XCODEBUILD_AUTH_ARGS:-}
scripts.test:ios: yarn sync:ios && rm -rf build/ios-test-results.xcresult && SIM=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep iPhone | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}' | head -1) && xcrun simctl bootstatus $SIM -b && xcodebuild test -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -destination "id=$SIM" -retry-tests-on-failure -resultBundlePath build/ios-test-results.xcresult COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
scripts.release:android: NODE_ENV=production yarn sync:android && NODE_ENV=production yarn release:android:aab && NODE_ENV=production cap build android --androidreleasetype APK --signing-type apksigner && mkdir -p build && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-signed.apk android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release-signed.aab build/
scripts.release:android:aab: cap build android --androidreleasetype AAB && jarsigner -sigalg SHA256withRSA -digestalg SHA-256 -keystore "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH" -storepass:env ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -keypass:env ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD -signedjar android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release-signed.aab android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS"
